**Subject: Launch position and October 8 staging demo**

Hi Avery,

The October 8 production launch is no longer the current position. The security review is now expected to complete October 12 at the earliest, and the release requires completed approval before production launch. The review may also require remediation, so no new production date is authorized yet.

The team remains focused on completing the required security work and moving forward responsibly. We can still hold a staging demo on October 8 using synthetic data.

Please confirm whether you would like to accept the October 8 staging demo. Nia owns the security review, and we will update the launch position once the review and approval are complete.

Best,  
Jordan
